name: Russia–Ukraine
value: Abu Dhabi talks day 2; ZNPP power cut 8 Nov
summary: US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi held a second day on 11 Nov; Zaporizhzhia plant lost off-site power on 8 Nov
state: Russia, Ukraine and the US held a second day of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi on 11 Nov, opening in a trilateral format, Ukraine's negotiator Umerov said (Interfax-Ukraine; HuffPost); US envoys are due to meet President Putin in Moscow next (France 24). The Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant lost external power on 8 Nov before the IAEA reported it restored (ThePrint); this safety incident sets the Alert. No ceasefire was announced as of 11 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Ukraine, Russia and neighbouring countries. Talks have not yet changed conditions on the ground.
rubric_hit: Nuclear-plant safety incident (ZNPP off-site power loss 8 Nov) = Alert
